name: Mika AI Chat
author: hiremika

sections.description:
Mika is a 24/7 sales assistant for small businesses. It lives on your website around the clock, answers visitor questions using your actual business information, captures leads, and handles appointment requests. No coding, no scripts, no flow building.

Unlike most chatbots, Mika reads your website automatically and keeps learning from anything else you share, including service details, pricing, and the stories behind your business. It holds natural conversations and sends you warm leads the moment a visitor is ready to connect.

Mika is powered by a self-learning visitor conversion engine informed by behavioral science research. It selects the right approach for each visitor based on what they type, what page they are on, and how the conversation unfolds.

Why Small Businesses Choose Mika

  • Free forever plan with around 30 conversations per month, enough for most startups and brand new sites that are just launching
  • Works in 13 languages with Auto-Detect mode (English, Spanish, Mandarin, French, Vietnamese, Korean, Tagalog, Arabic, Russian, Portuguese, German, Italian, Japanese)
  • Set up in minutes. Install the plugin, paste your API key, done
  • No scripts or decision trees. Mika reads your website and answers naturally
  • Captures leads automatically. Name, email, phone, and a summary of what the visitor needs
  • Handles appointment requests. Visitors share their preferred date and time; you confirm in your own calendar
  • Built for WooCommerce. Live product search inside chat with photo cards, variants, and inventory awareness
  • Privacy Mode for healthcare practices. Zero-storage option that processes visitor messages and discards them
  • Proactive visitor engagement. Exit intent detection, scroll triggers, and returning visitor greetings
  • Follow-up email sequences. Automated thank-you, reminder, review request, and rebook emails after appointments
  • Structured knowledge base. Add FAQ pairs Mika uses to answer questions precisely, with automatic gap detection
  • Team management. Invite staff with role-based access (owner, admin, staff) and per-staff booking availability
  • Works on any WordPress theme. Compatible with Elementor, Divi, Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress, and all major page builders

Built for Three Kinds of Businesses

Mika is shaped by what real owners told us they actually need. The features below are organized by the kind of business you run.

1. Local Service Businesses

If you run a salon, dental office, home services company, law practice, accounting firm, or any other local business, you already pay for every website visitor through ads or SEO. Most of them leave without saying a word. Mika talks to them.

The pain we kept hearing from owners: contact forms get a 2-3% fill rate, after-hours calls go to voicemail, and visitors who do not get an instant answer book somewhere else by morning.

What Mika does for local service businesses:

  • 24/7 lead capture, including evenings and weekends
  • Instant email notification with the visitor’s name, contact, and a summary of what they need
  • Appointment request handling so visitors share preferred date and time, then you confirm
  • Custom guardrails to keep conversations on topic and aligned with your business
  • Proactive triggers that start conversations before visitors leave (exit intent, scroll, returning visitor)
  • Automated follow-up email sequences after appointments (thank-you, reminders, review requests, rebook)
  • 13 languages with Auto-Detect mode
  • Free forever plan with around 30 conversations per month
  • Paid plans start at $9.99/month for around 5 to 10 conversations per day, with a 14-day free trial

2. Healthcare Practices (Dentists, Therapists, Optometrists, Accountants)

The pain we kept hearing from practice owners: most chat vendors claim compliance, but cannot explain where messages are stored, who has access, or whether anything is logged. Compliance officers reject vendors that cannot answer those questions.

Mika offers a Privacy Mode that takes a different approach. Instead of trying to claim compliance, it stores nothing.

What Mika does for healthcare practices:

  • Zero-Storage Healthcare Privacy Mode. Visitor messages are processed and discarded. No transcripts, no contact info persisted in our database.
  • Healthcare guardrails. Mika never asks about symptoms, diagnoses, or medications. All clinical questions are redirected to scheduling.
  • Appointment requests only. Mika collects name, contact, preferred date and time, and general service. Nothing more.
  • Secure notifications. Lead details are delivered through a one-time encrypted link. PIN is sent via a separate channel. Both are required to view the details.
  • Tamper-evident audit log with cryptographic verification for every privacy event.
  • Available on Standard Pro ($49.99/month). Privacy Mode is enabled during managed onboarding. Contact us at hiremika.com to set it up.

We do not claim HIPAA compliance and we do not provide BAAs. The value of Privacy Mode is that there is nothing stored to breach in the first place.

3. WooCommerce Stores

The pain we kept hearing from store owners: shoppers want a personal shopper who knows the catalog, not a chatbot that loops them or just answers basic FAQs. Existing chat tools cannot search products and the AI add-ons get expensive fast.

Mika is the only widget that searches your WooCommerce catalog live during a conversation and renders product photo cards inline.

What Mika does for WooCommerce stores:

  • Live product search inside chat. Visitors describe what they want and Mika searches your catalog and shows photo cards with prices and variants.
  • Color, size, and price filtering. Customers ask “do you have this in large under $50?” and Mika checks inventory and answers with real options.
  • Catalog auto-sync. New SKUs show up automatically throughout the day. No manual re-sync.
  • Two CTAs on every product card. “View on site” sends them to the product page; “More info” continues the conversation.
  • Out-of-stock awareness. Mika never recommends what you cannot ship.
  • Retail Starter $30/month with a 14-day free trial. Up to 500 SKUs.

Works With Your Favorite Plugins

Mika runs alongside the plugins you already use:

  • WooCommerce – Live product search in chat with photo cards, variants, and stock awareness
  • MemberPress – Convert visitors browsing your offerings into paying members
  • LearnDash – Help prospective students find the right course
  • BuddyBoss – Answer community questions and drive signups
  • Gravity Forms / WPForms – Replace static forms with live conversations
  • Bookly / Amelia – Mika captures appointment requests alongside your existing booking plugin
  • Elementor / Divi / Beaver Builder – Floating widget works on any page builder

Honest About What Mika Will and Will Not Do

Too many chat tools overpromise and embarrass the businesses that install them. Here is what Mika will not do:

  • No live agent handoff. When Mika cannot answer, she gracefully tells the visitor a team member will reach out, then emails you their question. There is no human waiting in a queue and no “transferring you to an agent” dead end.
  • No outbound phone calls. Mika does not dial out or return calls. If a visitor wants to speak with someone, Mika captures the request and emails you.
  • No medical advice. With Privacy Mode enabled, Mika refuses to discuss symptoms, medications, or diagnoses.
  • No fake confirmations. When something fails on the back end, Mika tells the visitor honestly instead of pretending an appointment is booked.

Free Plan (no credit card required)

Mika has a true free forever plan, not a 14-day trial that disappears. It is designed for startups and brand new businesses just launching their website, and it covers most of them comfortably.

Every Mika account starts with a free plan that includes:

  • Around 30 conversations per month, enough for the typical just-launched site
  • Lead capture with instant email notifications
  • 13-language support with Auto-Detect mode
  • Custom welcome message
  • Works on any website
  • No credit card, no time limit, no surprise upgrade prompts

Paid Plans

Standard plans for service and professional businesses (estimated daily conversation volume, not hard limits):

  • Core ($9.99/mo) – Around 5 to 10 conversations per day, appointment requests, custom guardrails, 14-day free trial
  • Plus ($19.99/mo) – Around 10 to 20 conversations per day, auto follow-up emails, custom personality, brand colors, proactive triggers, returning visitor greetings, team accounts
  • Pro ($49.99/mo) – Unlimited conversations per day, full widget customization, dedicated account team, Privacy Mode available, SMS lead alerts

Retail plans for WooCommerce shops with product search:

  • Retail Starter ($30/mo) – 500 SKUs, 14-day free trial
  • Retail Core ($50/mo) – 2,000 SKUs
  • Retail Pro ($100/mo) – Unlimited SKUs

How It Works

  1. Sign up at hiremika.com (free, no credit card)
  2. Mika scans your website and learns your business: services, hours, location, and more
  3. Review and customize your welcome message, personality, and goals
  4. Install this plugin, paste your API key, and enable the widget
  5. Start capturing leads. Mika answers visitor questions and sends you warm leads via email

Industries That Use Mika

Mika works for any small business with a website. Popular industries include:

  • Dental offices and medical practices (with Zero-Storage Privacy Mode)
  • Therapy and counseling practices (with Zero-Storage Privacy Mode)
  • Law firms and legal practices
  • Accounting and financial advisory firms (with Zero-Storage Privacy Mode)
  • HVAC, plumbing, and home services
  • Real estate agencies
  • Salons and spas
  • Car dealerships (with live inventory search and photo cards)
  • Retail stores and boutiques (with product catalog search)
  • Restaurants and hospitality
  • Course creators and membership sites
  • And 20+ more industry-specific configurations

What This Plugin Does

This plugin adds the Mika widget to your WordPress site by inserting a small JavaScript snippet in your site’s footer. The snippet loads the widget from api.hiremika.com, which displays a floating chat button on your pages.

When visitors click the chat button, they have a conversation with Mika. Mika uses the information from your website to answer questions, capture contact details, and handle appointment requests.

External service: This plugin connects to hiremika.com, a third-party service operated by Dcipher LLC. Visitor chat messages are sent to Mika’s servers for processing. No WordPress admin data, user accounts, or site configuration is transmitted. Review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Plugin Features

  • One-click installation from the WordPress plugin directory
  • Settings page under Settings > Mika AI Chat
  • Test Connection button to verify your API key works
  • Enable/disable toggle to control when the widget appears
  • Widget position selector (bottom-right or bottom-left)
  • Page exclusion to hide the widget on specific pages or posts
  • Per-page disable checkbox in the post/page editor sidebar
  • Clean uninstall removes all plugin data when deleted
  • Lightweight with zero impact on page load speed (script loads asynchronously)
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the mika-ai-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Mika AI Chat
  4. If you do not have a Mika account, sign up for free
  5. Paste your API key (found in your Mika dashboard under Overview)
  6. Click Test Connection to verify your key
  7. Check Enable Widget and click Save Changes
  8. Visit your site to see the Mika chat button in the bottom-right corner
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

Sign up for a free account at hiremika.com/signup. After Mika scans your website, you will find your API key on the dashboard Overview page. It starts with pk_.

Is Mika really free?

Yes. The free plan includes around 30 conversations per month, lead capture, and 13-language support with Auto-Detect mode. No credit card required, no time limit. It is built for startups and just-launched sites and covers most of them. When your site outgrows it, paid plans start at $9.99/month for around 5 to 10 conversations per day, with a 14-day free trial on Core.

What data is sent to hiremika.com?

Only visitor chat messages typed into the widget are sent to Mika’s servers for processing. No WordPress admin data, user credentials, database content, or site configuration is transmitted. See our Privacy Policy.

Does Mika book appointments directly into my calendar?

No. Mika handles appointment requests. Visitors share their preferred date, time, and service. You receive an email notification and confirm the appointment in your own calendar. This is intentional. It keeps you in control and prevents double bookings.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, and it does more than just appear on the page. With a Retail plan, Mika searches your WooCommerce product catalog live during conversations, shows photo cards inline, filters by color and size and variant, and respects stock levels. Visitors can ask “do you have this in large?” and get a real answer. Catalog syncs throughout the day so new products appear automatically.

Does it work with MemberPress or LearnDash?

Yes. Mika runs on any WordPress page, including membership gates, course pages, and checkout flows. It helps convert visitors who are browsing your offerings but have not signed up yet.

I run a healthcare practice. Is this safe to use with patients?

Mika offers a Privacy Mode that stores nothing. Visitor messages are processed and discarded. Healthcare guardrails prevent Mika from discussing symptoms, diagnoses, or medications, redirecting all clinical questions to scheduling. Privacy Mode is available on Standard Pro and is enabled during managed onboarding at hiremika.com. We do not claim HIPAA compliance or provide BAAs. The point of Privacy Mode is that there is nothing stored to breach in the first place.

Will Mika ever discuss medical conditions or give health advice?

No. With Privacy Mode enabled, Mika refuses to engage with symptom, diagnosis, or medication questions and redirects them to scheduling.

Can multiple team members access the dashboard?

Yes. Invite team members with role-based access: owners manage billing and account settings, admins manage content and configuration, and staff can view conversations and manage their own appointments.

Does it work with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Yes. Mika loads as a floating widget overlay and does not interfere with any page builder. It works with Elementor, Divi, Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress, Beaver Builder, and all other WordPress themes and page builders.

Can I hide the widget on specific pages?

Yes, two ways: (1) Enter comma-separated page IDs in the Exclude Pages field on the settings page, or (2) check the “Disable Mika Chat” box in the sidebar when editing any page or post.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The Mika script loads asynchronously and does not block page rendering. The initial script is under 10KB. All heavy resources load only when a visitor opens the chat.

Can I customize the widget colors and appearance?

Yes, but customization is managed from your Mika dashboard, not from WordPress. Brand colors are available on the Plus plan. Full widget customization is available on the Pro plan.

Does Mika support multiple languages?

Yes. Mika has Auto-Detect mode, so it detects the visitor’s language from their message and responds in kind. Supported languages: English, Spanish, Mandarin, French, Vietnamese, Korean, Tagalog, Arabic, Russian, Portuguese, German, Italian, and Japanese.

What happens if Mika cannot answer a question?

Mika gracefully tells the visitor that a team member will reach out, captures their contact details, and emails you the question. No loops, no “transferring you to an agent” dead ends.

What if I have more conversations than my plan estimates?

The conversation counts on each plan are estimates of typical daily volume, not hard caps. If you have a busy day, conversations are not cut off mid-chat. If your usage consistently runs above the next tier, we will let you know so you can upgrade.

I have a Content Security Policy (CSP) that blocks external scripts. What do I do?

Add api.hiremika.com to your CSP script-src and frame-src directives. If you use a WordPress security plugin like Wordfence or iThemes Security, add api.hiremika.com to the allowed domains list.
